prompt:
The `smarty` extension gets nested quotes wrong when both quotes close at the end of a sentence. For example

    "Quoted words at the 'end.'"

should produce `“Quoted words at the ‘end.’”`, and

    (He replied, "She said 'Hello.'")

should produce `(He replied, “She said ‘Hello.’”)`. Currently the closing pair is turned into the wrong quote characters (an opening quote where a closing one belongs). The mirror case with single quotes outside and double quotes inside has the same problem, and so does the same text inside a `<span>`.
